    Marathi Vocabulary

    Marathi Words for Daily Life (with Hindi & English)

    Marathi words for home, routine, body and everyday objects — the vocabulary daily conversation is built from.

    216 words · Units 03, 10

    Curated by xmirtunjay for Bol Marathi ·Reviewer: pending native-speaker review ·how the curriculum works

    • What you will learn
    • The words

    What you will learn

    216 everyday Marathi words (home, routine, body, adjectives, adverbs) — each with Hindi meaning, English meaning, pronunciation and a real example sentence from the Bol Marathi curriculum.

    The vocabulary of an ordinary day: home and household objects, daily routine, body parts, and the describing words (adjectives) and how-words (adverbs) that flesh out sentences — from Units 03 and 10. Each entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and an example. This is the largest cluster because daily life needs the most words; adjectives and adverbs are included here since they modify exactly these nouns and verbs.

    Tip: Narrate your routine in Marathi as you do it — brushing, cooking, leaving.
